title: Astronomical events calendar plugin should show exact time of the astronomical events
line: Moon phases and solstices/equinoxes in the clock's calendar now show the exact time they happen, on the right local day.
explanation: The astronomical events plugin made every moon phase and season an all-day event, because KHolidays could only say on which date they happen. Seasons were also put on their UTC date, so in far-off time zones a solstice could show a day early (the part of duplicate 498563 still open). KHolidays now computes the exact moment of the four principal moon phases and of each season with Meeus' algorithms (within a minute of published times), and phaseAtDate() uses the same moments so dates and times always agree. The plugin shows them as timed events on their local date, and the digital clock no longer prints the same time twice for events that start and end at the same moment.

commits.message:
Add the exact time of lunar phases and astronomical seasons

Lunar phases and seasons could only be given as a date, so apps could
not show when they happen. Add LunarPhase::phaseDateTime() and
AstroSeasons::seasonDateTime(), computed with Meeus' algorithms.

BUG: 477088

plasmacalendarplugins/astronomical: show the time of each event

Moon phases and seasons were shown as all-day events, without the time
they happen at, and seasons were put on their UTC date. Show them at
their exact time instead, on their date in the local time zone.

BUG: 477088

applets/digital-clock: don't repeat the time of instant events

Events that start and end at the same moment, like a full moon from
the astronomical events plugin, showed the same time twice. Only show
the start time for them.

BUG: 477088

patches.diff:
From 7da8b0179e419d1a9d3710662bc61c19184ddda7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:28:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: don't repeat the time of instant
 events

Events that start and end at the same moment, like a full moon from
the astronomical events plugin, showed the same time twice. Only show
the start time for them.

BUG: 477088
---
 applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
index 48d5dcccb7..cb02a08bed 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/CalendarView.qml
@@ -339,7 +339,7 @@ PlasmaExtras.Representation {
                                 horizontalAlignment: Qt.AlignRight
                                 opacity: 0.75
 
-                                visible: eventItem.hasTime
+                                visible: eventItem.hasTime && eventItem.modelData.endDateTime - eventItem.modelData.startDateTime !== 0
                             }
 
                             Kirigami.SelectableLabel {
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Today's full moon is listed without any time.
The full moon shows the time it happens, 3:53 PM in Rome.
In Auckland the December solstice is put on Dec 21 (its UTC date), with no time.
It is now on Dec 22 at 9:50 AM, local time in Auckland.
